system_description.narrative_title: US-led de-escalation of Iran war and oil-market ripple effects
system_description.narrative_summary: Across the window, US political signals — notably from President Trump and envoys — are pushing a pause toward negotiated or lower-intensity US–Iran confrontation, while Gulf states shore up military coordination and regional actors (Houthis, Iran, Saudi assets) continue episodic strikes. Financial and commodity markets are reacting: oil and gas prices are retreating as the geopolitical risk premium eases, even as supply-route vulnerabilities and production rebounds keep upside risks alive.
system_description.scope: Interactions among US policy signals and diplomacy, Iranian responses, Gulf Arab military coordination and strikes (including Houthi activity), energy infrastructure attacks and production adjustments, shipping-route flows (Hormuz and alternative routes), and market/price responses in oil, gas, and equities.
adjacent_subsystems: Middle East regional security and military posture
International shipping and chokepoint security (Hormuz, pipelines, tankers)
evidence_headlines: Trump says US military action against Iran not necessary 'at this point'
Oil falls below $90 as Trump downplays prospect of escalation with Iran
Gulf Arab states approve military command headquarters in Kuwait
Saudi East-West oil pipeline hit in Medina region, state media reports
Exclusive | Vance Reaches Out to Iranian Hard-Liner in Bid to Restart Peace Talks
Oil prices hit 10-week low after Donald Trump says strikes on Iran ‘highly unlikely’

variables.name: Military tension level
variables.description: Measures the intensity of armed-threat interactions and readiness among regional and external military actors.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, scale, and intensity of formal and informal diplomatic contact aimed at de-escalation or negotiation.

variables.name: Regional military coordination strength
variables.description: Measures the degree of institutionalized coordination and interoperability among regional military actors' command and control arrangements.

variables.name: Non-state attack frequency
variables.description: Measures the rate of hostile actions initiated by non-state armed groups (e.g., missile, drone, or maritime attacks) per unit time.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure attack rate
variables.description: Measures the rate of successful or attempted attacks specifically targeting energy infrastructure such as pipelines, terminals, and refineries.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure operational capacity
variables.description: Measures the proportion of regional energy infrastructure capacity available and functioning relative to pre-crisis baseline.

variables.name: Oil production rate
variables.description: Measures gross oil output from regional producers expressed as volume per unit time.

variables.name: Oil supply disruption risk
variables.description: Measures the perceived probability and expected severity of interruptions to regional oil supply flows.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: Measures the prevailing market price per unit of crude oil denominated in common market currency.

variables.name: Gas price level
variables.description: Measures the prevailing market price per unit of natural gas in relevant regional markets.

variables.name: Equity market sentiment
variables.description: Measures aggregate investor risk appetite and market tone in equities in response to geopolitical and commodity developments.

variables.name: Shipping route throughput
variables.description: Measures the volume of energy-related cargo transiting primary regional sea lanes or chokepoints per unit time.

variables.name: Shipping security incident rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency of hostile incidents affecting commercial shipping (attacks, interdictions, or seizures) in regional routes.

variables.name: Alternative route utilization rate
variables.description: Measures the share of regional energy shipments rerouted via non-primary sea lanes, pipelines, or logistical alternatives per unit time.

variables.name: Strategic fuel reserve level
variables.description: Measures the aggregate stock level of government-held emergency fuel reserves available to stabilize supply and markets.

variables.name: Market geopolitical risk premium
variables.description: Measures the portion of commodity and asset prices attributable to perceived geopolitical risk rather than fundamentals.

catalysts.title: U.S. decision to strike or show restraint
catalysts.description: Ongoing White House policy signaling whether to launch strikes on Iran or maintain restraint, shaping escalation risk and markets.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: Trump says strikes 'highly unlikely' and 'not necessary at this point'; signals restraint and pause to Iran war.

catalysts.title: Kuwait Gulf military command HQ operationalization
catalysts.description: Approved Gulf Arab command HQ in Kuwait moves from approval toward activation, increasing regional military coordination.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Gulf Arab states approve military command headquarters in Kuwait' implies activation and improved coordination.

catalysts.title: Continuation of Houthi attacks (land, maritime, energy)
catalysts.description: Ongoing Houthi missile, drone and maritime strikes against shipping and Saudi infrastructure continue, sustaining security risks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: repeated Houthi strikes—tanker hit, pipeline/pumping station attacks, missiles/drones intercepted, Aramco damage.

catalysts.title: Repair and restoration of Saudi East–West pipeline
catalysts.description: Post-attack repair operations on Saudi East–West pipeline and affected facilities proceed, affecting flows and market perceptions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Saudi East-West oil pipeline hit' and subsequent reports of pumping-station attacks imply repair operations underway.

catalysts.title: OPEC+ output nears prewar levels (Saudi rebound)
catalysts.description: OPEC+ production recovery—led by Saudi rebound—continues toward prewar output, easing tightness in oil markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'OPEC’s Oil Production Nears Prewar Levels' and 'Saudi oil production rebounds close to prewar levels'.

catalysts.title: Vance outreach and direct talks push
catalysts.description: U.S. envoy Vance's outreach and consideration of direct talks with Iranian hard-liners could restart limited diplomacy.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Vance Reaches Out to Iranian Hard-Liner' and 'Vance Considers Direct Talks With Iran Hard-Liner'.

catalysts.title: New U.S. Congress convenes
catalysts.description: Incoming U.S. Congress takes office, with potential legislative pressure to end hostilities or constrain war policy.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Can a new US Congress mean an end to the Iran war?' and polls urging Congress to end the war.

catalysts.title: EU deliberation on designating Houthis terrorist
catalysts.description: Pressure from Saudi Arabia prompts EU consideration of labeling Yemen’s Houthis a terrorist group, with diplomatic and security implications.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Saudi Arabia puts pressure on EU to label Yemen's Houthis a terrorist group.'

catalysts.title: Adnoc evaluation to bypass Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: ADNOC's assessment of alternative export routes to avoid the Strait continues, potentially shifting shipping and routing decisions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Adnoc Gas Still Evaluating Options to Bypass Strait of Hormuz' indicates ongoing rerouting evaluation.
